children: OpenAI is getting an unusually large financial incentive as companies compete for its rapidly growing demand for computing capacity.

SB Energy issued OpenAI warrants valued at roughly $5.5 billion as part of an effort to secure the artificial intelligence company as a major data-center customer, according to a Wall Street Journal report.
The size of the package shows how valuable OpenAI has become to companies building infrastructure for the AI boom.
Warrants give their holder the right to buy equity under predetermined terms, potentially allowing OpenAI to benefit financially if SB Energy's value rises.

The relationship already extends beyond a conventional customer agreement. OpenAI previously invested about $500 million in SB Energy, while Nvidia has committed roughly $3 billion to the venture, according to the report.
For SB Energy, landing OpenAI could provide long-term demand for projects that require billions of dollars of upfront investment.
For OpenAI, the structure could lower the effective cost of securing the enormous amount of power and data-center capacity needed to train and operate increasingly advanced models.
The arrangement also shows how AI infrastructure deals are evolving beyond simple leases and supply contracts.

As OpenAI expands toward the public markets, investors will increasingly watch how these complex infrastructure agreements affect its spending requirements, ownership stakes and long-term computing costs.

title: OpenAI Just Got a $5.5 Billion Data Center Sweetener
